_readme: Single source of truth for categories, crafts and listings. status: available | sold | hidden. images: base paths; the site loads <base>-600.webp, <base>-1000.webp and <base>.jpg. Optional item fields (row hidden when missing): unit, stock_note, maker, origin, technique, craft, materials, size, care, featured, vinted. Items with placeholder:true keep unconfirmed values under _proposed; move a value up a level once Roos confirms it.

contact._whatsapp_note: Left empty on purpose: the number was removed from public pages for privacy. Set to https://wa.me/<number> to show WhatsApp buttons.

shipping_note: Sent from the Netherlands with tracking through Vinted’s shipping options, anywhere in the EU. Returns are handled through Vinted’s buyer protection.

categories.name: Jewellery
categories.blurb: Bangles, necklaces and earrings — handpicked from artisans and markets across India.

categories.name: Textiles
categories.blurb: Block prints, scarves and woven pieces. New textiles are on their way from India.

categories.name: Lunchboxes
categories.blurb: Classic Indian stainless steel tiffins — built to last a lifetime, plastic-free.

temple.name: Temple jewellery
temple.text: First made to adorn deities in South Indian temples, and now worn at weddings and festivals. Dense relief work with goddesses, peacocks and lotus motifs.

blockprint.name: Block printing
blockprint.text: Patterns carved into wooden blocks and pressed onto cotton by hand, one colour at a time. Small shifts in the print are the mark of the hand.

steel.name: Steel tiffins
steel.text: The stacking lunch carrier that has gone to work, to school and onto trains for generations. Plain steel, no plastic, made to be used every day for decades.

kundan.name: Kundan setting
kundan.text: Stones set in layers of fine foil, a technique refined in the royal courts of Rajasthan. Made for celebration and often handed down.

jhumka.name: Jhumka earrings
jhumka.text: Bell-shaped drops that move as you walk — one of the oldest earring forms in India, worn every day and at every festival.

bangles.name: Bangles
bangles.text: Worn in stacks, given at weddings and births, and part of daily life across India. Each set is chosen to be worn together or on its own.

items.title: Neelam Two-Tier Steel Tiffin
items.description: A classic Indian stainless steel tiffin by Neelam (since 1972). Two stacking compartments, a lid with a fold-down carry handle, and a clip that locks all three together. Sized for one good lunch.
